examples.text: It seems clear to me that swimming is good for the whole body. (B2 VANTAGE; 1993; Swedish; Pass)
It is obvious that some people prefer reading books. (Poland; B2 VANTAGE; 2008; Polish; Pass)
It is possible that we can be educated by TV. (Japan; B2 VANTAGE; 2004; Japanese; Pass)
It seems obvious that it is not necessary. (Switzerland; B2 VANTAGE; 2008; French; Pass)
It does not seem possible that we can live without any private life. (Japan; B2 VANTAGE; 2000; Japanese; Pass)
It is likely that by reading books we will learn some new words and phrases so that we will be able to write better. (Poland; B2 VANTAGE; 2008; Polish; Pass)
It is possible that only one computer will do this. (Moldova (Republic of); B2 VANTAGE; 2000; Russian; Pass)
They are unlikely to arrive on Friday. (India; B2 VANTAGE; 2008; Hindi; Pass)
We are sure to increase our turnover and at least our profit. (Austria; B2 VANTAGE; 2008; German; Pass)
Whenever money is involved, some problems are likely to happen. (Spain; B2 VANTAGE; 2000; Spanish - European; Pass)
If you see a movie, it is likely to have been made with computers. (Switzerland; B2 VANTAGE; 1999; French; Pass)
It is clear that we can't live without computers today. (Russia; B2 VANTAGE; 1999; Russian; Pass)
It seems obvious that this oil comes from the gas station. (other; B2 VANTAGE; 2008; French; Pass)

Computers became part of the human life style because they help us to make our lives easier, but it is clear that we should never depend on machines to handle our lives. (Mexico; B2 VANTAGE; 1999; Spanish - Latin American; Pass)
Due to the introduction of a new staff appraisal form, it is crucial that you take part. (Switzerland; B2 VANTAGE; 2010; Swiss German; Pass)
It's obvious you can't ride forty kilometres twice a day, unless you're very sporty. (France; B2 VANTAGE; 1993; French; Pass)
